responsibility: This file implements the standalone lto-dump front-end behavior for inspecting LTO object files rather than optimizing them. It defines the dump-mode command handlers that read LTO symbols/callgraph state and then print symbol lists, individual symbol details, Graphviz callgraph output, selected GIMPLE bodies, and optional tree/gimple statistics, including sorting and demangling options from lang.opt; its lto_main is therefore a diagnostic/query driver over streamed IL, distinct from the optimizing LTO driver in lto.c.
